svg.text: Add the quota banner to the settings page, ENG-413 in Linear, design in the Figma link.
Reading the ticket, its Figma frame and the quota fields the API now returns.
The banner sits above the search form and reads dailyLimit and usedToday from
/v1/account. At the limit it turns red and disables New search, as in the frame.
Tests pass. I pushed to me/eng-413-quota-ui: CI is running on web#1836 (5/9 jobs)
and the preview sandbox picks it up once the image is built.
